ns2:section.sectionText: Topic Section C: Workshop on Publishing Articles in Literary and Interdisciplinary Journals This workshop will offer Ph.D. students the opportunity to revise extensively an existing seminar paper or a dissertation chapter for submission to a scholarly journal. In addition, dissertation-writing students will be able to discuss next stages after completing their dissertations--specifically, how to begin to revise a dissertation into a marketable book manuscript. Students will be responsible for detailed, thoughtful criticism of others? work in a relaxed, conversational setting, and for substantively revising their own work during the summer session. At the end of the session each student will provide a completed essay to submit to a suitable journal.
